description_en: Changes the instance type and storage space of a node in a MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 变更MongoDB分片集群实例中节点的规格和存储空间
kebab_example: aliyun dds modify-node-spec --db-instance-id dds-bp1c0b9901840000 --node-id s-bp143e1b16370000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNodeSpec

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shard or Mongos node in the sharded cluster instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html operation to query the node ID.

If you set this parameter to the ID of a shard node, you must also specify the NodeStorage parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分片集群实例中Shard节点ID或Mongos节点ID，您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62010.html接口查询。

当传入的值为Shard节点ID时，还需要传入NodeStorage参数
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the shard or Mongos node. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.help_zh: Shard节点或Mongos节点的规格，规格详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/57141.html
parameters.name: node_class

parameters.help_en:
The storage space of the shard node. The step size is 10. Unit: GB.

SSD local disk: 10 to 2000.

ESSD PL1 disk: 20 to 16000
parameters.help_zh:
Shard节点的存储空间，步长为10，单位：GB。

SSD本地盘，取值范围：10~2000。
ESSD PL1云盘，取值范围：20~16000
parameters.name: node_storage

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The source of the request. Valid values:

OpenApi: The request is from OpenAPI.

mongo_buy: The request is from the console
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源，取值说明：
OpenApi：请求来源为OpenApi。
mongo_buy：请求来源为控制台
parameters.name: from_app

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true (default): Enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

false: Disables automatic payment. You must manually pay for the order
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：
true（默认值）：自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
false：手动付费
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The effective time of the configuration change. Valid values:

Immediately (default): The change takes effect immediately.

MaintainTime: The change takes effect during the O\&M window of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
变更配置的生效时间，取值说明： 
Immediately（默认值）：立即生效。
MaintainTime：实例可运维时间段内生效。
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en:
The time when the configuration change takes effect. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

This parameter is deprecated. Use the EffectiveTime parameter instead
parameters.help_zh: 变更配置的执行时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 该参数已废弃，请替换使用 EffectiveTime 参数
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:

UPGRADE: upgrades the instance configuration.

DOWNGRADE: downgrades the instance configuration
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型，取值说明：
UPGRADE：升配。
DOWNGRADE：降配
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the shard node.

Valid values: 0 to 5. The value must be an integer
parameters.help_zh:
调整Shard节点中只读节点的个数。

取值范围：0~5（整数）
parameters.name: readonly_replicas

parameters.help_en: The business information. This is an additional parameter
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

default or null (default): A coupon is used.

youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: A coupon is not used
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
The primary zone to which you want to migrate the instance.

<notice>

This parameter is applicable only to instances that use disks.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的目标主可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
parameters.name: target_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The secondary zone to which you want to migrate the instance.

<notice>

This parameter is applicable only to instances that use disks.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的目标secondary可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
parameters.name: target_secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The hidden zone to which you want to migrate the instance.

<notice>

This parameter is applicable only to instances that use disks.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的目标Hidden可用区。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
parameters.name: target_hidden_zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone.

<notice>

This parameter is applicable only to instances that use disks.

</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的目标VswitchId。
<notice>只支持云盘实例。></notice>
parameters.name: target_vswitch_id
